row: Wildlife Rehabilitation Outpost is a non-profit wildlife rescue dedicated to the indigenous animals of Mississippi. Our goal is to rehabilitate and release injured, orphaned, and sick wildlife while educating and sharing our dream along the way! We are not a sanctuary, our goal is ALWAYS release back into the wild.
